title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to sterilization vouchers issued in Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26 through the Department of Animal…
text:
[Council File 26-0533]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to sterilization vouchers issued in Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26 through the Department of Animal Services (DAS) Spay and Neuter Program.
Recommendations for Council action:
1. NOTE and FILE the DAS report dated June 25, 2026, attached to the Council file, inasmuch as the report is for informational purposes only.
2. INSTRUCT the DAS to report on resources needed to ensure spay and neuter vouchers are going to those that need the subsidized voucher, along with the projected number of procedures that will be completed during FY 2026-27, compared to the last five years and how an increase of funding can assist those who qualify for a voucher. Also, report if there are any limitations by providers in administering the vouchers.
3. INSTRUCT the DAS to report back on possible programs to address the need for spay and neuter in areas of high need, like Skid Row, including organizations that they may need to contract with.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A Department of Animal Services report on how many spay and neuter sterilization vouchers were issued and redeemed in fiscal year 2025-26.
